title: Evaluating Large Language Models with NeuBAROCO: Syllogistic Reasoning Ability and Human-like Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on syllogistic reasoning tasks using the NeuBAROCO dataset, specifically comparing accuracy on logically valid inferences that are consistent versus those that are inconsistent with common-sense human beliefs.

Testing LLMs on syllogistic inference problems where the incorrect logical conversion of categorical terms (e.g., misinterpreting 'All A are B' as 'All B are A') leads to a systematically incorrect reasoning conclusion.

Assessing LLMs on specific syllogism patterns where the structural 'atmosphere' (the quality or quantity, such as negative or particular terms) of the premises tempts an incorrect, heuristic-based logical conclusion.
